_meta.purpose: Data behind the C1 estimated-1RM chart in index.html
_meta.confidence: NSCA chart values VERIFIED from the published NSCA Training Load Chart. Epley and Brzycki are standard published formulas.

nsca_load_chart_pct._comment: TrainHeroic quote: 'Estimated 1RM are calculated directly from the NSCA load chart, based on the best effort of 15 reps or less.' The chart defines 1-10 and 12 ONLY. 11 is interpolated here. 13/14/15 are UNDEFINED yet still accepted as input.

recommendation.must_store: formula id alongside every computed e1RM, so history stays reproducible when the default changes
recommendation.known_artefact: Epley returns 103.3 for a 1-rep set at 100kg — it is not calibrated at r=1. Special-case it.
